scope: 27 recently pictured candidate profiles; partial multi-publisher bibliography and recording index, with selected source-attributed summaries.
method: Exact full names or aliases grounded by the reviewed candidate portrait/current-role sources. Punctuation boundaries retained. All candidate-matching recording titles inspected; ambiguous identities, conflicting departments and unsupported attack framing withheld. No article bodies published; no claim of exhaustive internet coverage or full playback/fact verification of every indexed recording.
